name: How long does a roof penetration leak assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof penetration leak assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof penetration leak assessment varies based on the roof's size, complexity, and the number of penetrations. Typically, a standard residential assessment can take anywhere from 1 to 3 hours. Larger commercial properties or those with multiple suspected leak areas may require more time for a thorough inspection. Our team prioritizes a meticulous examination of each penetration point, including flashing, sealants, and surrounding materials, to ensure all potential issues are identified. Factors like weather conditions can also influence the assessment timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The assessment usually takes 1 to 3 hours for residential roofs, depending on size and complexity. Larger roofs may take longer.
